answer: A practical defence is Hardware secure element key with manufacturer attestation. It rests on a key born inside the chip that never leaves it, which gives every honest agent a sable that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the falcon compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The fable is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
